scope: Decision-only source/fixture review. Guard positions deliberately varied in fresh clones to confirm sensitivity; no claim these are natural reached sessions.
sourceFindings: Fixed main/alternate core orders are explicit.
pathSafe weights actual nontrapped guard Manhattan distance (0:+1000,1:+14,2:+5,3:+1).
excavate chooses between legal left/right stands with guard-distance costs.
Same-row guard 2–4 cells away triggers a legal dig if available.
L3 alternate bottom return also has a fixed far-side ladder waypoint; policy is a hybrid of route design and reactive guard weighting, not anticipatory planning.
